corrections.text: The article states Andrew Rabert began rewriting Jellyfin's desktop app 'in December 2025, according to Linuxiac.' Linuxiac's report does not state a start date for the rewrite. The December 2025 date comes from Rabert's own account in GitHub issue andrewrabert/jellium-desktop#609: 'I was the developer who started the rewrite of the desktop client in December 2025.' The date itself is accurate; only the source attribution was wrong.
